    MIN_TILES - Static variable in class imageproof.LocalAnomaly

    MIN_TVD - Static variable in class imageproof.LocalAnomaly
    Smallest neighbour TVD (0.10) that can count; tiny absolute differences are ignored.
    MIN_VARIANCE - Static variable in class imageproof.CopyMove
